enabled.title: Enable Alibaba Java Development Manual checks
enabled.description: When off, nothing is reported and the quick fixes disappear too.

group.constant.title: Constants
group.constant.description: The long literal suffix must be an uppercase L.

group.naming.title: Naming Style
group.naming.description: Eleven rules: camel case, uppercase constants with underscores, array brackets next to the type, no is prefix on boolean fields, lowercase package names, test classes ending in Test, and a method length limit.

group.concurrent.title: Concurrency
group.concurrent.description: No Executors thread pools, no explicit new Thread, no Timer, no static SimpleDateFormat, and no static Random.

group.collection.title: Collections
group.collection.description: Pass a correctly typed array to toArray, do not add to or remove from an Arrays.asList result, and do not cast a subList view to ArrayList.

group.flow.title: Flow Control
group.flow.description: Braces on if/for/while/do, a default branch in switch, no return in finally, no add or remove inside foreach, and no + string concatenation in a loop.

group.oop.title: OOP
group.oop.description: Put the string constant, or the object known to be non-null, on the left of equals, and do not construct BigDecimal from a double.

group.other.title: Misc
group.other.description: Use yyyy rather than YYYY in date patterns, System.currentTimeMillis for the current time, no Apache BeanUtils, no Pattern.compile inside a method body, no int/long cast of Math.random, and no == on floating-point values.

group.exception.title: Exceptions
group.exception.description: @Transactional should specify rollbackFor so checked exceptions also roll back.

comment.abstractMethodJavadoc.title: Abstract and interface methods must have Javadoc
comment.abstractMethodJavadoc.description: Leave this off on a legacy project until the comments are filled in, or it will flood the list.

comment.enumConstantJavadoc.title: Enum constants must have a comment
comment.enumConstantJavadoc.description: Leave this off on a legacy project until the comments are filled in, or it will flood the list.

comment.classMustHaveAuthor.title: Classes must have an @author tag
comment.classMustHaveAuthor.description: Leave this off on a legacy project until the comments are filled in, or it will flood the list.

collection.initCapacity.title: Specify an initial capacity for hash collections
collection.initCapacity.description: Flags no-arg new HashMap/HashSet and similar. Leave off if you prefer the defaults; it can be noisy.

maxMethodLines.title: Maximum lines per method
maxMethodLines.description: The handbook suggests 80 lines; whole-line comments are not counted. The minimum is 1.
